name: Crude and product tankers with scrubbers or LNG fuel
aliases: Crude and product tankers with scrubbers or LNG fuel
principle: Tankers carry crude and products in size classes from Aframax (80,000 to 120,000 dwt) to VLCC (200,000 to 320,000 dwt, about 2 million barrels). Ships meet the sulphur limit with low-sulphur fuel, exhaust scrubbers or LNG; the IMO page could not be read, so limits are not on this card.
key_equipment: scrubber or LNG fuel gas system

source.note: Wikipedia, Oil tanker, read 25 October 2026 (secondary source)
Wikipedia, Oil tanker, read 25 October 2026 (secondary source)

advantages: Economies of scale on long routes
limitations: Wikipedia gives conflicting double-hull phase-out dates (2010 and 2026)
